evidence.note: Agent enumerated the test surface (137 golden cases, ~10K lines) — shows awareness of the scale of what would need tracking, but this is scoping, not pass/fail tracking.
Only ever ran `cargo check` to confirm the skeleton/edits compile; never ran `cargo test`, the parity suite, or any command that would reveal a pass count.

Made two foundational edits (link.rs, network.rs) then submitted 'task complete' with no measurement of which tests pass vs remain and no ledger of status — explicitly acknowledges the tests 'will fail' without ever having run them.

reasoning: The agent never ran the test suite even once, so it had no live picture of pass/fail status and made edits without any net pass count — squarely the anchor-0 description ('fixes things without knowing net pass count'). It rises marginally above pure 0 only because it enumerated the 137-case test surface and confirmed compile state, but it maintained no ledger, tracked no remaining failures, and abandoned the work before any progress could be measured.
